reason_before_result: Measure whether the predictive information documented in the literature has economically relevant magnitude on a named venue: gross conditional markout versus signal quantile.
primary_metric: gross conditional markout by signal quantile
secondary_metrics: signal autocorrelation; quantile monotonicity; regime slices
required_preconditions: Named instrument, order-level historical data with validated timestamps, causal state builder
notes: Baseline ladder step 1 and 2 of the project's G2 gate. No model beyond deterministic imbalance/microprice formulas is required.

reason_before_result: Measure signal decay: execution-aware EV at controlled artificial delays, to replace every 'next tick' assumption with a measured curve.
secondary_metrics: gross markout versus delay; implied break-even delay; delay-grid sensitivity
required_preconditions: EXP-0001 artifacts plus a conservative execution model
notes: Delay grid is an experiment design choice, not an asserted market half-life: 0/10/25/50/100/250/500 ms and 1/2/5 s where physically appropriate.

reason_before_result: Estimate passive fill probability conditional on queue state under the venue's actual matching rule, and validate the simulator against shadow observations.
secondary_metrics: partial-fill rate; queue-position error; fill latency
required_preconditions: Order-level replay data, written matching rule for the exact contract, live shadow path
notes: Touch=fills is disallowed as a baseline; the simulator must distinguish executions from cancellations where the feed allows it.

reason_before_result: Measure adverse selection: markout distribution conditional on own fills, for passive and crossing execution.
secondary_metrics: expected markout by queue position; toxicity-conditioned markout
notes: This is the measurement that decides whether an apparent spread capture is real.

reason_before_result: Produce a cost-sensitivity surface: does the candidate's sign survive conservative fee/slippage/spread assumptions?
primary_metric: sign stability of execution-aware net edge
secondary_metrics: break-even fee level; break-even spread level
required_preconditions: Verified venue fee schedule for the project's account path
notes: Required by the project's own G4 robustness gate; cheap and can kill a branch.

reason_before_result: Run the same-information baseline ladder (no-trade/passive, random-side, logistic, LightGBM/XGBoost, hand-authored rule) on the measured signal.
secondary_metrics: log loss; Brier; calibration slope/intercept; risk-coverage
notes: Mandatory comparator set before any neural or System-One variant may be considered.

reason_before_result: Profile this project's own shadow path: source event, receive, feature-complete, model start and end, decision, submit, ack, fills.
required_preconditions: Instrumented shadow runtime with the project's timestamp contract
notes: Measurement only; no order is sent.

reason_before_result: Sealed post-cost out-of-sample utility test of the surviving candidate against the baseline ladder, with a preregistered kill criterion.
primary_metric: sealed net utility versus baseline ladder
secondary_metrics: multiple-testing controls (PBO/DSR where applicable); regime breakdown
required_preconditions: M1-B completion, frozen dataset version, preregistered thresholds
notes: Cannot be registered until M1-B selects a finalist and M1-D1 is authorized.

reason_before_result: Measure incremental execution-aware utility of a System-One/Jev policy over the same-information classical baseline on sealed data.
primary_metric: incremental net utility (System-One minus classical baseline)
secondary_metrics: p50/p95/p99 decision age; calibration diagnostics; semantic perturbation stability
required_preconditions: A funded, measured System-One path and a completed baseline ladder
notes: Locked out by default; this row exists so the burden of proof is explicit. Vendor-reported latency is not an input.
